page.text:
Robert
Rivas
Donate
Robert Rivas
# Endorsements
DOLORES HUERTA
Civil Rights Leader
Speaker Robert Rivas was raised in farmworker housing, and he never forgets where he comes from. He is fiercely committed to improving the lives of working people. His leadership is making a real difference for workers, families, and all Californians. I am proud to stand with Speaker Rivas as he fights for justice, equity, and opportunity for all.
ZOE LOFGREN
United States Representative
Speaker Robert Rivas is fearless in protecting our state’s residents from those who would take away their rights and freedoms. He stands up for Californians, no matter who is in the White House. We need his voice now more than ever.
SIMÓN SALINAS
Former California State Assemblymember
Former Monterey County Supervisor
I have known and worked with Robert for many years. It is no surprise to me that he has been such an effective Speaker. Since he first entered public service, he has been driven by the highest moral standards. He takes on the most difficult issues and always, always finds a way to make progress. He gives me hope for California’s future.
JEFF ROSEN
Santa Clara County District Attorney
Speaker Robert Rivas has shown bold and decisive leadership in tackling the retail theft crisis that impacts businesses and communities across California. Thanks to his leadership, law enforcement and prosecutors now have better tools to hold criminals accountable and protect our local businesses. This is a major step forward in making our communities safer. I fully support and applaud Speaker Rivas for his dedication to public safety and his unwavering leadership.
SUSAN ELLENBERG
Santa Clara County Supervisor
In these tumultuous political times, Speaker Robert Rivas is focused, calm, and clear about his values. He is fighting to protect every Californian, no matter who they are. He is respected across the state for his ability to listen to people and bring them together to solve complex problems. That’s why he’s so effective. It has been an honor to work with him.
ANTHONY BOTELHO
Former San Benito County Supervisor & Local Farmer
As a local elected official for over 20 years, I know how rare it is to find a leader like Speaker Robert Rivas. He has an unmatched ability to build consensus and bring people together from all backgrounds to get things done. California needs leaders like Speaker Rivas, and I’m proud to support him.
Titles for identification purposes only.
